tests.name: bson_one_pass_basic_object
tests.intent: Verify that a simple JSON object serializes correctly via to_bson(j) using the single-pass writer.

tests.name: bson_one_pass_nested_containers
tests.intent: Verify single-pass BSON serialization on deeply nested objects and arrays.

tests.name: bson_two_pass_vector_overload
tests.intent: Verify that calling to_bson(j, vector) invokes the two-pass writer and produces identical output.

tests.name: bson_error_handler_replace
tests.intent: Verify that using error_handler_t::replace forces the two-pass fallback path without error.

tests.name: bson_error_handler_ignore
tests.intent: Verify that using error_handler_t::ignore forces the two-pass path correctly.

tests.name: bson_null_byte_in_key_exception
tests.intent: Verify that a null byte in an object key throws an exception in the single-pass writer.

tests.name: bson_discarded_value_exception
tests.intent: Verify that serializing a discarded value throws an exception.

tests.name: bson_fixed_size_numeric_array
tests.intent: Verify single-pass handling of large homogeneous numeric arrays which trigger the fixed-size array writer optimization.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_check
tests.intent: Verify serialization of binary data with valid and invalid subtypes.

tests.name: bson_empty_containers
tests.intent: Verify that empty objects and arrays are correctly sized and written in a single pass.

tests.name: bson_stream_output_adapter
tests.intent: Verify writing BSON to an output stream (using two passes / output adapters).

tests.name: bson_mixed_types_array
tests.intent: Verify arrays containing a mixture of types, including nested objects and arrays.

tests.name: bson_boolean_and_null_values
tests.intent: Verify single-pass handling of boolean and null values inside objects and arrays.

tests.name: bson_string_utf8_strict
tests.intent: Verify string handling under strict UTF-8 checking in single-pass BSON writing.

tests.name: bson_multiple_numeric_ranges
tests.intent: Verify various integer and floating point bounds in single-pass BSON generation.

tests.name: bson_deeply_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Verify deeply nested arrays to stress single-pass stack frame management and parent tracking.

tests.name: bson_wide_integer_fallback
tests.intent: Verify that values requiring wide integers trigger proper handling behavior.

tests.name: bson_large_document_size_limit
tests.intent: Verify fallback behavior when a document exceeds the 32-bit BSON size limit.

tests.name: bson_large_array_index_naming
tests.intent: Verify array index string generation (crossing digit boundary thresholds like 10, 100, 1000) in single-pass.

tests.name: bson_roundtrip_equality
tests.intent: Verify that serialization via single-pass BSON can be correctly parsed back and matches original JSON.
